description: This file contains the implementation of the Category controller within the admin catalog namespace of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages various aspects of category management in the admin interface, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting categories, as well as handling form submissions and interactions with models for categories, stores, filters, and descriptions.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: The 'Category' controller class manages CRUD operations for product categories in the admin panel, including listing categories, editing category details, handling form submissions, and rendering relevant views for category management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the category overview page, setting up the page title, breadcrumbs, and calling the list method to display categories.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the category list page, including pagination, sorting, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of categories, applying filters, sorting, pagination, and returning the view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Sets the response output to the rendered category list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the category form for creating or editing a category, including loading existing data and supporting multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submissions for saving new or updated categories, including validation and model interactions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected categories based on posted IDs and updates the category list accordingly.
